# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c30 P4](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0004), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Stacy  <sub>[v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>; Miss Muriel Stacy  <sub>[v1 c30 P0](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0000)</sub>

## Personality

Miss Stacy is an empathetic, insightful, and devoted educator who deeply cares for her students and forms strong connections with them. She maintains high ethical standards, encouraging her pupils to form respectable habits and acquire noble ideals, while gently addressing misbehavior like deceit without holding grudges. She offers wise, practical counsel regarding academic preparation and personal well-being, inspiring deep loyalty and affection from her pupils.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy served as the schoolteacher in Avonlea, succeeding Mr. Phillips. During her tenure, she took a personal interest in her advanced students, establishing an after-school class to prepare them for the Queen's Academy entrance examination and visiting Marilla Cuthbert to encourage Anne Shirley's participation. She frequently guided her pupils on moral development and good habits, correcting missteps such as Anne's reading of unauthorized novels during class with gentle understanding. Though offered a teaching position in her home district's grade school, Miss Stacy chose to remain in Avonlea out of devotion to her pupils. She coached the Queen's class through their studies, advising them against last-minute cramming prior to exams, and completed her term at the end of June to the deep sadness of her students.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009)_
